Source One cannot deny the fact that Bigg Boss Hindi is one of the most loved shows across the nation.
 According to reports, Bigg Boss 20 has been getting impressive TRP ratings since the show premiered. 
 Murmurs are doing the rounds that the show makers are planning a double eviction in Bigg Boss 20 for this weekend. Yes, what you read is right. Netizens also predicted who will get eliminated from the show. 
 Aman and Mary Kom are likely to get evicted from Bigg Boss 20 in the upcoming Weekend Ka Vaar episode.
 Actor Salman Khan is hosting Bigg Boss 20, and the show will air on Colors TV at 10:30 pm.
